"""Publish the completed matched trial only after audits and actual native viewing.

No model inference is performed. Checkpoint construction/loading is CPU-only
and starts after terminal-owner, audit, source and viewing checks.
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live, read, ref
from train_phase_evidence_trial import ARMS, METHODS, REPO, ROOT, factory, guard, save

STEM = "v178-phase-evidence-v1"
INDEX = REPO / "docs/results/v178-phase-evidence-final-v1.json"
REPORT = REPO / "docs/phase-evidence-comparison.md"
IMAGES = REPO / "docs/images" / STEM
EVIDENCE = REPO / "docs/results" / STEM
VERIFICATION = REPO / "docs/results/v178-phase-evidence-publication-verification-v1.json"


def terminal_result(root, phase, filename, expected_status):
    launch = read(root / f"{phase}-launch-v1.json")
    if owner_live(launch["owner"]):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Actual {phase} owner is still live")
    if (root / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json").exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f"Preserved {phase} failure requires inspection")
    result = read(root / filename)
    if result["owner"] != launch["owner"] or result["status"] != expected_status:
        raise ValueError(f"Wrong terminal {phase} owner/status")
    return result


def completed_context(root, *, viewed=False):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    seal = read(root / "publication-source-v1.json")
    if ref(__file__) != seal["publisher"]:
        raise ValueError("Use the sealed publication entry")
    for binding in seal["helpers"]:
        if ref(binding["path"]) != {k: binding[k] for k in ["path", "sha256"]}:
            raise ValueError("Publication helper bytes changed")
    training = {
        arm: terminal_result(
            root,
            f"{arm}-train",
            f"{arm}-train-result-v1.json",
            "completed-matched-warmstart-one-pass",
        )
        for arm in ARMS
    }
    scores = terminal_result(
        root,
        "review",
        "scores-v1.json",
        "completed-four-endpoint-fixed-quality-awaiting-native-viewing",
    )
    controller = terminal_result(
        root,
        "controller",
        "controller-result-v1.json",
        "completed-matched-trial-quality-render-awaiting-actual-viewing",
    )
    binding = ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
    for result in [*training.values(), scores]:
        if result["plan"] != binding:
            raise ValueError("Actual results must bind the same plan")
    for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
        audit = read(root / name)
        if not audit["status"].startswith("pass-") or audit["plan"] != binding:
            raise ValueError("Both actual audits must pass")
    if read(root / "quality-audit-v1.json")["scores"] != ref(root / "scores-v1.json"):
        raise ValueError("Quality audit binds different scores")
    figures = read(root / "figures-v1.json")
    if (
        figures.get("fixture", False)
        or figures["plan"] != binding
        or figures["scores"] != ref(root / "scores-v1.json")
        or controller["figures"] != ref(root / "figures-v1.json")
        or figures["native_figures"] != 72
        or figures["native_triplets"] != 24
        or len(figures["images"]) != 72
        or sum(item["triplet"] for item in figures["images"]) != 24
        or not all(item["no_resize"] for item in figures["images"])
        or len(figures["sheets"]) != 18
        or sorted(i for s in figures["sheets"] for i in s["indices"]) != list(range(72))
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected actual 72-figure render bound to terminal results")
    paired = read(root / "paired-comparisons-v1.json")
    if paired["plan"] != binding or paired["scores"] != ref(root / "scores-v1.json"):
        raise ValueError("Matched comparisons bind different actual results")
    if (
        len(paired["table_cells"]) != 714
        or not paired["status"].startswith("completed-")
        or paired["methods"] != 13
        or paired["metric_rows"] != 10686
        or paired["matched_endpoint_contrasts"] != 2
        or paired["contrasts"] != 34
        or paired["real_references_scored"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected all matched/context tables")
    if viewed:
        viewing = read(root / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json")
        if viewing["figures"] != ref(root / "figures-v1.json") or viewing["indices"] != list(
            range(72)
        ):
            raise ValueError("All actual native figures must have recorded viewing")
        if ref(viewing["journal"]["path"]) != viewing["journal"]:
            raise ValueError("Viewing journal changed")
    return plan, training, scores, figures, paired


def record_viewing(root, selected, notes):
    _, _, _, figures, _ = completed_context(root)
    if (
        not selected
        or not notes.strip()
        or len(selected) != len(set(selected))
        or not set(selected) <= set(range(18))
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected distinct actual sheet indices0..17 and viewing notes")
    journal = root / "native-viewing-v1.jsonl"
    events = (
        [json.loads(line) for line in journal.read_text().splitlines()] if journal.exists() else []
    )
    seen = {i for event in events for i in event["sheets"]}
    if seen & set(selected):
        raise ValueError("A sheet viewing is already recorded")
    for index in selected:
        binding = figures["sheets"][index]["image"]
        if ref(binding["path"]) != binding:
            raise ValueError("Viewed sheet bytes differ from render")
    event = {
        "recorded_unix_UTC": time.time(),
        "sheets": selected,
        "detail": "original",
        "notes": notes,
    }
    with journal.open("a") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
    events.append(event)
    seen.update(selected)
    if seen == set(range(18)):
        save(
            root / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "actually-viewed72-native-figures-in18-original-detail-sheets",
                "figures": ref(root / "figures-v1.json"),
                "journal": ref(journal),
                "events": events,
                "indices": list(range(72)),
                "native_figures": 72,
                "native_triplets": 24,
                "no_resize": True,
            },
        )
    print(f"Recorded sheets{selected};viewed{len(seen)}/18")


def export_checkpoints(plan, training, scores):
    import torch
    from phase_evidence_training_state import load_matching_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    directory = Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "exports"
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    base = torch.load(
        plan["frozen_component"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
    )
    exports = {}
    for arm in ARMS:
        checkpoint = training[arm]["final_checkpoint"]
        assert ref(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint
        state = torch.load(checkpoint["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]:
            module = factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).eval()
            module.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
            if endpoint == "EMA":
                load_matching_ema(module, state["ema"])
            method = METHODS[arm][endpoint]
            expected = scores["module_hashes"][method]["before"]
            assert model_hash(module) == expected
            assert model_hash(module.frozen) == plan["frozen_component"]["module_hash"]
            config = dict(plan["module_config"])
            if arm == "control":
                config.pop("evidence_peaks")
            source = (
                REPO
                / "src/demosaic"
                / (
                    "late_local_noise_matching.py"
                    if arm == "control"
                    else "late_phase_evidence_matching.py"
                )
            )
            path = directory / f"phase-evidence-{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000.pt"
            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                torch.save(
                    {
                        "component": type(module).__name__,
                        "module_config": config,
                        "state_dict": module.state_dict(),
                        "parent": base["parent"],
                        "frozen_component": plan["frozen_component"],
                        "sampling_library": plan["sampling_library"],
                        "source": ref(source),
                        "source_checkpoint": checkpoint,
                        "arm": arm,
                        "endpoint": endpoint,
                        "initial_checkpoint": plan["initial_checkpoint"],
                        "old_network_updates": 1800,
                        "new_optimizer_updates": 900,
                        "adapter_updates": 900 if arm == "evidence" else 0,
                        "training_plan": ref(Path(plan["root"]) / "plan-v1.json"),
                    },
                    stream,
                )
            restored = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            fresh = factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).eval()
            fresh.load_state_dict(restored["state_dict"], strict=True)
            assert model_hash(fresh) == expected
            exports[method] = {
                "export": ref(path),
                "source_checkpoint": checkpoint,
                "state": endpoint,
                "arm": arm,
                "module_hash": expected,
                "component": restored["component"],
                "module_config": config,
                "source": restored["source"],
                "full_state_tensors": len(fresh.state_dict()),
            }
            del module, fresh, restored
        del state
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    return exports


def evidence_names():
    names = [
        "plan-v1.json",
        "admission-inspection-v1.json",
        "controller-result-v1.json",
        "training-audit-v1.json",
        "quality-audit-v1.json",
        "scores-v1.json",
        "quality-events-v1.jsonl",
        "quality-observations-v1.jsonl",
        "review-launch-v1.json",
        "review-status-v1.json",
        "paired-comparisons-v1.json",
        "comparison-tables-v1.md",
        "figures-v1.json",
        "native-viewing-v1.jsonl",
        "native-viewing-completion-v1.json",
        "audit-source-v1.json",
        "report-source-v1.json",
        "publication-source-v1.json",
        "controller-source-v1.json",
        "controller-launch-v1.json",
        "controller-owner-v1.json",
        "draft-v1.json",
        "controller-prepare-v1.log",
        "controller-v1.log",
        "control-train-v1.log",
        "evidence-train-v1.log",
        "review-v1.log",
    ]
    for arm in ARMS:
        names.extend(
            f"{arm}-{suffix}"
            for suffix in [
                "train-result-v1.json",
                "train-launch-v1.json",
                "train-status-v1.json",
                "train-trace-v1.jsonl",
                "restoration-v1.json",
                "warmstart-v1.json",
            ]
        )
    return names


def publish(root, notes):
    plan, training, scores, figures, paired = completed_context(root, viewed=True)
    if not notes.is_file() or len(notes.read_text()) < 300:
        raise ValueError("Actual human quality notes are required")
    for path in [INDEX, REPORT, IMAGES, EVIDENCE, Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "exports"]:
        if path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(path)
    names = evidence_names()
    if not all((root / name).is_file() for name in names):
        raise FileNotFoundError("Required actual evidence is missing")
    for item in figures["images"]:
        if ref(item["image"]["path"]) != item["image"]:
            raise ValueError("Native image bytes changed")
    needed = sum((root / name).stat().st_size for name in names)
    needed += sum(Path(item["image"]["path"]).stat().st_size for item in figures["images"])
    # Includes strict exports, index/report/source metadata and a publication margin.
    needed += 128 * 2**20
    if shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free < (48 + 0.5) * 2**30 + needed:
        raise RuntimeError("Insufficient reserved local publication space")
    exports = export_checkpoints(plan, training, scores)
    IMAGES.mkdir()
    EVIDENCE.mkdir()
    images = []
    for item in figures["images"]:
        source = Path(item["image"]["path"])
        destination = IMAGES / source.name
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        assert destination.read_bytes() == source.read_bytes()
        images.append(dict(item, original_image=item["image"], image=ref(destination)))
    manifest = IMAGES / "manifest-v1.json"
    save(
        manifest,
        {
            "images": images,
            "method_checkpoints": exports,
            "source": ref(root / "figures-v1.json"),
            "native_figures": 72,
            "native_triplets": 24,
            "no_resize": True,
            "fixture": False,
            "frozen_component": plan["frozen_component"],
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    copies = {}
    for name in names:
        source = root / name
        destination = EVIDENCE / name
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        assert source.read_bytes() == destination.read_bytes()
        copies[name] = {"original": ref(source), "public": ref(destination)}
    note_copy = EVIDENCE / "human-quality-notes-v1.md"
    shutil.copyfile(notes, note_copy)
    text = "# Matched phase-evidence trial: completed quality\n\n" + notes.read_text().strip()
    text += "\n\n[Exact evidence](results/v178-phase-evidence-final-v1.json) · "
    text += "[Native-pixel viewer](images/v178-phase-evidence-v1/native-viewer.html).\n\n"
    text += (root / "comparison-tables-v1.md").read_text().rstrip() + "\n\n"
    text += "RMS is camera-RGB DN16; template gain1 means exact constructed amplitude. "
    text += "Matched feature inputs and3,120parameters change together. V175 has a larger "
    text += "fresh-noise budget. Reused inputs do not establish blind generalization, seed "
    text += (
        "uncertainty or noisy-sky safety. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references are qualitative, not GT.\n\n"
    )
    text += "## Native comparisons\n\nAll cells retain160×160 source pixels without resizing. "
    text += "The manifest records source/ROI, checkpoint/state, physical noise, exposure, "
    text += "contrast, anchor and qualified references for every view. Both protected GFX "
    text += "families/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded from training.\n\n"
    for triplet, title in [
        (False, "Comparison boards"),
        (True, "Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT"),
    ]:
        text += f"### {title}\n\n"
        for item in images:
            if item["triplet"] != triplet:
                continue
            text += f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, "
            text += f"exposure{item['exposure']:g}, contrast{item['contrast']:g}.\n\n"
            text += f"![Native comparison](images/{STEM}/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
    text += "[Publication verification](results/v178-phase-evidence-publication-verification-v1.json).\n"
    with REPORT.open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(text)
    save(
        INDEX,
        {
            "status": "completed-matched-trial-audited-actually-viewed-and-four-strict-exports",
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "copies": copies,
            "notes": ref(note_copy),
            "report": ref(REPORT),
            "figures": ref(manifest),
            "checkpoints": exports,
            "table_cells": 714,
            "native_figures": 72,
            "native_triplets": 24,
            "execution": {
                "new_training_rows": sum(len(value["trace"]) for value in training.values()),
                "new_optimizer_updates": sum(value["updates"] for value in training.values()),
                "new_training_images": sum(value["training_images"] for value in training.values()),
                "training_counts": {arm: value["counts"] for arm, value in training.items()},
                "quality_counts": scores["counts"],
                "quality_ADC_exact": scores["ADC_outputs_exact_V169"],
                "quality_frozen_replays": scores["exact_V169_replays"],
                "new_parent_DINO_calls": 0,
                "new_sensor_source_draws": 0,
                "admission_is_a_separate_completed_probe": True,
            },
            "publication_source": ref(root / "publication-source-v1.json"),
            "actual_new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_sensor_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": paired["scope"],
        },
    )
    print("Published72nativefigures/714tablecells/4strictCPUexports;zero model forwards")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="phase", required=True)
    viewing = sub.add_parser("record-viewing")
    viewing.add_argument("--sheets", required=True)
    viewing.add_argument("--notes", required=True)
    publishing = sub.add_parser("publish")
    publishing.add_argument("--notes", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.phase == "record-viewing":
        record_viewing(ROOT, [int(n) for n in args.sheets.split(",")], args.notes)
    else:
        publish(ROOT, args.notes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify actual matched exports, copied evidence, native crops and browser pixels."""

import argparse
import re
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from publish_phase_evidence_trial import (
    ARMS,
    IMAGES,
    INDEX,
    METHODS,
    REPO,
    REPORT,
    ROOT,
    VERIFICATION,
    completed_context,
    factory,
    read,
    ref,
    save,
)


def verify(diary):
    plan, training, scores, figures, paired = completed_context(ROOT, viewed=True)
    if VERIFICATION.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(VERIFICATION)
    final = read(INDEX)
    assert final["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    for key in ["report", "figures", "notes", "publication_source"]:
        assert ref(final[key]["path"]) == final[key]
    for pair in final["copies"].values():
        for binding in pair.values():
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        assert (
            Path(pair["original"]["path"]).read_bytes() == Path(pair["public"]["path"]).read_bytes()
        )
    seal = read(final["publication_source"]["path"])
    assert seal["verifier"] == ref(__file__)
    for binding in seal["helpers"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == {k: binding[k] for k in ["path", "sha256"]}
        if "text" in binding:
            assert Path(binding["path"]).read_text() == binding["text"]

    import torch
    from phase_evidence_training_state import load_matching_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from reduce_phase_evidence_trial import tables
    from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    strict_loads = 0
    for arm in ARMS:
        source = torch.load(
            training[arm]["final_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
        )
        for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]:
            method = METHODS[arm][endpoint]
            entry = final["checkpoints"][method]
            assert entry["source_checkpoint"] == training[arm]["final_checkpoint"]
            assert entry["state"] == endpoint and entry["arm"] == arm
            assert ref(entry["export"]["path"]) == entry["export"]
            exported = torch.load(entry["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            actual = factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).eval()
            actual.load_state_dict(exported["state_dict"], strict=True)
            expected = factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).eval()
            expected.load_state_dict(source["models"], strict=True)
            if endpoint == "EMA":
                load_matching_ema(expected, source["ema"])
            assert (
                model_hash(actual)
                == model_hash(expected)
                == scores["module_hashes"][method]["before"]
                == entry["module_hash"]
            )
            assert model_hash(actual.frozen) == plan["frozen_component"]["module_hash"]
            assert exported["component"] == type(actual).__name__ == entry["component"]
            assert (
                exported["old_network_updates"] == 1800 and exported["new_optimizer_updates"] == 900
            )
            assert exported["adapter_updates"] == (900 if arm == "evidence" else 0)
            assert exported["source_checkpoint"] == entry["source_checkpoint"]
            assert ref(exported["source"]["path"]) == exported["source"] == entry["source"]
            strict_loads += 1
            del actual, expected, exported
        del source

    table_text, cells = tables(paired["summary"])
    assert len(cells) == 714 and cells == paired["table_cells"]
    assert (ROOT / "comparison-tables-v1.md").read_text() == table_text + "\n"
    assert table_text in REPORT.read_text() and final["report"] == ref(REPORT)
    manifest = read(final["figures"]["path"])
    assert manifest["fixture"] is False and manifest["method_checkpoints"] == final["checkpoints"]
    assert len(manifest["images"]) == 72 and sum(i["triplet"] for i in manifest["images"]) == 24
    prior = read(plan["prior_figures"]["path"])
    old_map = {item["image"]["path"]: item for item in prior["images"]}
    new_channels = copied_channels = 0
    for item in manifest["images"]:
        assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"] and item["no_resize"]
        assert Path(item["image"]["path"]).parent == IMAGES
        assert (
            Path(item["image"]["path"]).read_bytes()
            == Path(item["original_image"]["path"]).read_bytes()
        )
        old = old_map[item["source_figure"]["path"]]
        assert item["source_figure"] == old["image"] == ref(old["image"]["path"])
        assert all(item[k] == old[k] for k in ["ROI_xywh", "anchor", "contrast", "exposure"])
        image, old_image = [
            np.asarray(Image.open(v["path"]).convert("RGB")) for v in [item["image"], old["image"]]
        ]
        arrays = dict(np.load(item["case"]["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
        anchor = np.asarray(item["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        old_panels = {panel["label"]: panel for panel in old["panels"]}
        for panel in item["panels"]:
            label = panel["label"]
            x, y, width, height = panel["xywh"]
            assert width == height == 160
            if label in item["predictions"]:
                binding = item["predictions"][label]
                assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                value = np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
                expected_pixels = independent_display(
                    anchor + item["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor),
                    arrays,
                    item["ROI_xywh"],
                    item["exposure"],
                )
                new_channels += expected_pixels.size
            else:
                px, py, pw, ph = old_panels[label]["xywh"]
                expected_pixels = old_image[py : py + ph, px : px + pw]
                copied_channels += expected_pixels.size
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y : y + height, x : x + width], expected_pixels)
    assert new_channels == figures["new_RGB_channels_independently_checked"] == 16588800
    assert copied_channels == figures["unchanged_RGB_channels_copied"]
    browser = read(REPO / "docs/results/v178-native-viewer-verification-v1.json")
    assert not browser["fixture_only_no_actual_V178_quality"]
    assert browser["cases"] == 48 and browser["browser_crop_screenshots"] == 480
    assert browser["RGB_channels_exact_source_PNG"] == 36864000
    assert browser["manifest"] == ref(IMAGES / "manifest-v1.json")
    assert browser["viewer"] == ref(IMAGES / "native-viewer.html")
    assert browser["per_method_state_metadata_checked"] and browser["JS_errors"] == []

    diary = diary.resolve()
    assert diary.is_relative_to(REPO / "diary") and diary.is_file()
    documents = [
        REPO / name
        for name in [
            "README.md",
            "docs/index.md",
            "docs/current-model.md",
            "docs/research.md",
            "docs/experiments.md",
            "docs/phase-evidence-training.md",
            "docs/phase-evidence-matching.md",
            "docs/phase-evidence-comparison.md",
        ]
    ] + [diary]
    links = 0
    for path in documents:
        for target in re.findall(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)", path.read_text()):
            if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):
                continue
            resolved = (path.parent / target.split("#")[0]).resolve()
            assert resolved == VERIFICATION or resolved.is_file(), (path, target)
            links += 1
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    save(
        VERIFICATION,
        {
            "status": "pass-exact-evidence-four-exports-matched-tables-native-and-browser-pixels",
            "publication": ref(INDEX),
            "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
            "exact_receipt_copies": len(final["copies"]),
            "strict_CPU_export_loads": strict_loads,
            "matched_table_cells": 714,
            "native_figures": 72,
            "native_triplets": 24,
            "new_native_RGB_channels_recomputed": new_channels,
            "unchanged_native_RGB_channels_compared": copied_channels,
            "browser_RGB_channels_exact": 36864000,
            "document_links": links,
            "documents": {str(p): ref(p) for p in documents},
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_sensor_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_initialized": False,
            "scope": "Checks actual completed publication, not layout fixtures. Matched trial quality conclusions remain the recorded human interpretation; no blind-generalization or calibrated-noisy-sky claim follows from source/pixel integrity.",
        },
    )
    print(
        f"PASS four strict exports/714cells/72nativefigures/{new_channels + copied_channels}RGBchannels/{links}links"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--diary", type=Path, required=True)

"""Check actual raw/EMA matched browser captures against their public PNG pixels."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref
from PIL import Image
from train_phase_evidence_trial import METHODS, save


def verify(directory, output):
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output)
    browser = read(directory / "browser-records-v1.json")
    assert browser["fixture_only_no_V178_quality"] is False and browser["JS_errors"] == []
    assert len(browser["records"]) == 480 and len(browser["metadata"]) == 96
    viewer = Path(browser["viewer"])
    manifest_path = viewer.with_name("manifest-v1.json")
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    assert manifest["fixture"] is False and manifest["native_figures"] == 72
    assert set(manifest["method_checkpoints"]) == {
        method for endpoints in METHODS.values() for method in endpoints.values()
    }
    images = {item["image"]["path"]: item for item in manifest["images"] if not item["triplet"]}
    assert len(images) == 48
    for item in images.values():
        assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"]
    assert len({(m["case"], m["endpoint"]) for m in browser["metadata"]}) == 96
    for record in browser["metadata"]:
        for arm in ["control", "evidence"]:
            method = METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
            metadata = manifest["method_checkpoints"][method]
            assert metadata["state"] == record["endpoint"]
            for value in [method, metadata["source_checkpoint"]["sha256"], metadata["module_hash"]]:
                assert value in record["description"]
    channels = 0
    assert len({(r["case"], r["endpoint"], r["id"]) for r in browser["records"]}) == 480
    for record in browser["records"]:
        rect = record["rect"]
        assert rect["width"] == rect["height"] == 160
        assert rect["x"].is_integer() and rect["y"].is_integer()
        item = images[record["source"]]
        expected_panel = next(p for p in item["panels"] if p["label"] == record["label"])
        assert expected_panel["xywh"] == record["panel"]
        if record["id"] in ["a", "b"]:
            arm = "control" if record["id"] == "a" else "evidence"
            assert record["label"] == METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
        x, y, width, height = record["panel"]
        assert width == height == 160
        expected = np.asarray(Image.open(record["source"]).convert("RGB"))[
            y : y + height, x : x + width
        ]
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(record["screenshot"]).convert("RGB"))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
        channels += actual.size
    assert channels == 36864000
    save(
        output,
        {
            "status": "pass-actual-matched-browser-480-native-crops-checkpoint-state-and-source-pixels",
            "viewer": ref(viewer),
            "manifest": ref(manifest_path),
            "browser_records": ref(directory / "browser-records-v1.json"),
            "browser_version": browser["browser"],
            "cases": 48,
            "matched_raw_EMA_pairs": 96,
            "browser_crop_screenshots": 480,
            "RGB_channels_exact_source_PNG": channels,
            "rectangle_width_height": [160, 160],
            "per_method_state_metadata_checked": True,
            "matched_default_control_EMA_vs_evidence_EMA": True,
            "click_keyboard_flip_and_navigation": True,
            "JS_errors": [],
            "screenshot_bindings": [ref(r["screenshot"]) for r in browser["records"]],
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V178_quality": False,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
            "scope": "Actual headless-browser screenshot pixels and source/checkpoint-state metadata are checked. Image-quality gains and costs require the separate matched measurements and actual human native viewing.",
        },
    )
    print("PASS480actualbrowsercrops/36864000RGBchannels/raw+EMAstate-metadata")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify(args.directory.resolve(), args.output.resolve())

def write(path, value):

    monkeypatch.setattr(publication, "guard", lambda plan: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(publication, "owner_live", lambda owner: False)
    write(tmp_path / "plan-v1.json", {"unit_fixture": True})
    plan = publication.ref(tmp_path / "plan-v1.json")
    write(
        tmp_path / "publication-source-v1.json",
        {
            "publisher": publication.ref(publication.__file__),
            "helpers": [],
        },
    )
    for phase, name, status in [
        ("control-train", "control-train-result-v1.json", "completed-matched-warmstart-one-pass"),
        ("evidence-train", "evidence-train-result-v1.json", "completed-matched-warmstart-one-pass"),
        (
            "review",
            "scores-v1.json",
            "completed-four-endpoint-fixed-quality-awaiting-native-viewing",
        ),
        (
            "controller",
            "controller-result-v1.json",

        ),
    ]:
        owner = {"pid": 123456789, "created": 1.0}
        write(tmp_path / f"{phase}-launch-v1.json", {"owner": owner})
        write(tmp_path / name, {"owner": owner, "status": status, "plan": plan})
    scores = publication.ref(tmp_path / "scores-v1.json")
    for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
        write(tmp_path / name, {"status": "pass-unit-fixture-only", "plan": plan, "scores": scores})
    figures = {
        "plan": plan,
        "scores": scores,
        "native_figures": 72,
        "native_triplets": 24,
        "images": [{"no_resize": True, "triplet": i < 24} for i in range(72)],
        "sheets": [{"indices": list(range(i, i + 4))} for i in range(0, 72, 4)],
    }
    write(tmp_path / "figures-v1.json", figures)
    controller = publication.read(tmp_path / "controller-result-v1.json")
    controller["figures"] = publication.ref(tmp_path / "figures-v1.json")
    write(tmp_path / "controller-result-v1.json", controller)
    write(
        tmp_path / "paired-comparisons-v1.json",
        {
            "plan": plan,

            "table_cells": [{}] * 714,
            "status": "completed-unit-fixture-only",
            "methods": 13,
            "metric_rows": 10686,
            "matched_endpoint_contrasts": 2,
            "contrasts": 34,
            "real_references_scored": False,
        },
    )
    return tmp_path


def test_completed_looking_result_cannot_override_live_owner(boundary, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(publication, "owner_live", lambda owner: True)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="still live"):
        publication.completed_context(boundary)

def test_wrong_owner_status_or_preserved_failure_blocks_publication(boundary, change):
    path = boundary / "evidence-train-result-v1.json"
    value = publication.read(path)
    if change == "owner":

    elif change == "status":
        value["status"] = "completed-simulated-layout"
    else:
        write(boundary / "evidence-train-failure-v1.json", {"failed": True})

        publication.completed_context(boundary)

def test_missing_cli_notes_reject_before_torch_import():
    script = Path(publication.__file__).resolve()
    code = (
        "import runpy,sys;sys.argv=[sys.argv[1],'publish'];"
        "\ntry:runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')"
        "\nexcept SystemExit as error:"
        "\n assert error.code==2 and 'torch' not in sys.modules"
        "\nelse:raise AssertionError('Missing required notes accepted')"
    )
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", code, str(script)],

        text=True,
